config.title: Secure Token Rotation

intro.title: Secure Token Rotation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a React component that securely rotates an authentication token after a set time interval. You will learn how to use the useState and useEffect hooks in TypeScript to manage state and handle side effects. The main technologies involved are React for the UI, TypeScript for type safety, and JavaScript's setInterval for timing. By the end, you will understand how to implement automatic token refresh to keep user sessions secure.
intro.usecase: Secure token rotation is essential in any application handling user authentication and API security. You'll implement this pattern in dashboard applications where users remain logged in for extended sessions, like banking portals or project management tools. This ensures that access tokens are automatically refreshed before they expire, preventing users from being abruptly logged out during critical workflows. As a developer, you'll build this functionality to maintain seamless user experiences while keeping sensitive data protected against token theft or replay attacks.

objectives: Implement a React component that manages authentication token state using TypeScript interfaces
Construct a secure token refresh function that validates expiration timestamps
Configure an interval-based token rotation system with proper cleanup
Integrate token refresh logic with API request headers
Initialize and update token state in response to authentication events
Render conditional UI elements based on token validity status
Manipulate token storage in browser memory with appropriate security considerations
